learn.title: Around and inside
learn.body: Perimeter is the distance around a shape, measured in length units. Area is the amount of flat surface inside, measured in square units. They answer different questions, so a shape can have a large perimeter and a small area.

learn.title: Common area formulas
learn.body: Rectangle: $A=lw$. Square: $A=s^2$. Parallelogram: $A=bh$. Triangle: $A=\frac12bh$. Trapezoid: $A=\frac12(b_1+b_2)h$. Here $h$ is the height, measured at a right angle to the base, not along a slanted side.

learn.title: Compute areas
learn.body: Use the right formula each time.

learn.title: Split into simple parts
learn.body: A rectangle 10 by 8 has a 4 by 3 rectangle cut out of one corner.
Area is in square units, such as square metres. If a length doubles, the area quadruples. Do not mix units before multiplying.

questions.prompt: Find the area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6.
A rectangle is 9 by 4. Find its perimeter.
A parallelogram has base 8 and height 5. Find its area.
A trapezoid has parallel sides 6 and 10 and height 4. What is its area?

questions.explanation: Area counts squares of surface, so its units are squared.

questions.prompt: A triangle and a parallelogram have the same base and height. How do their areas compare?
choices: The triangle is half as big
The triangle is twice as big

questions.prompt: A 10 by 8 rectangle has a 4 by 3 rectangle removed. Find the area that is left.
A square has area 49. Find its perimeter.
questions.explanation: The side is $\sqrt{49}=7$, so the perimeter is $4\cdot7=28$.
